lore: Two lights stand above the DiskSaver channel; a pilot who keeps them in line comes home safe. Every page in the harbour library is a leading light for the next reader, and Lightkeeper Seraphine climbs to each one at dusk to see that its lamp still points at a real berth. A link to a berth that was torn down, or a path chalked on the quay that no longer leads anywhere, puts readers on the rocks.

lines.lit: Every lamp is trimmed and every one points at a berth that is really there. Steer by them.
lines.dim: No reader will run aground, but some marks have faded: an anchor gone, a path chalked to an old berth. I'll repaint them.
lines.dark: A lamp points at a berth that isn't there. Anyone who follows it lands on the rocks. Fix the link before dark.
